title: Peruvian Chickpea Causa
description: A twist on the classic Peruvian dish, featuring chickpea salad on a bed of mashed potatoes, topped with a zesty limena sauce.
instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with butter and milk.
In a separate pan, sauté the red onion and cilantro in olive oil until softened.
Combine the chickpeas, sautéed onion mixture, and lima juice in a bowl.
Season the chickpea mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
To assemble, place a layer of mashed potatoes on a serving plate, followed by a layer of the chickpea mixture.
Top with a drizzle of lima juice and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
